openQuestions: Partial breadth-first pass: inventoried 45 cards /52 generation-family records /57 raw entities; priority review covered 300, Pacifica, Voyager, 200, 300M, Crossfire, PT Cruiser, Sebring and Town & Country.
All four 300 records now ended; final modern family bound set to 2023 from explicit OEM calendar-year termination. Classic family starts and ends remain unknown; no model-year conversion was guessed.

Pacifica minivan production began 29 February 2016, independently explicit in OEM manufacturing story; hybrid followed December2016. Its current status has direct Windsor manufacturing corroboration in December2025.
Pacifica old crossover and current minivan remain separate; did not backfill crossover from/to using model-year2004–2008 labels.

Voyager card is scoped Europe/export and lacks a separately scoped modern North-American Voyager record. OEM retail-return release confirms MY2025 and fall2024 deliveries were planned; exact production scope/SOP still needs confirmation.
Grand Caravan is a Canadian Chrysler product in contemporary Windsor releases. Decide regional alias versus separately selected line; do not conflate with discontinued Dodge Grand Caravan.
The 1979 Cordoba-based Chrysler300 is absent as a separately scoped family; OEM historical story confirms its existence, but precise production bounds/body facts not verified in this pass.
Chrysler200/Crossfire/PT Cruiser/Sebring body and production histories require further primary-source work; no generation dates invented.
Photos, exact technical rows and complete raw-model concept/duplicate reconciliation remain open.
Norseman and Imperial Parade Phaeton raw entries warrant production-model versus concept/special-purpose selection review.
